Answer: F
Reason: The chest X-ray (lateral view) demonstrates a right-sided pneumothorax (indicated by the visceral pleural line and absence of lung markings peripherally) along with a well-defined intracavitary mass consistent with an aspergilloma in the right upper lobe. This combination explains the patient's symptoms and guides treatment, which may involve addressing both the fungal ball and the pneumothorax.
